company.name: Symbotic
company.shortDescription: Symbotic is a provider of integrated supply network automation solutions for warehouses and distribution centers.
company.description: Symbotic is a provider of integrated supply network automation solutions for warehouses and distribution centers. They developed proprietary and innovative robotics and software to deliver an advanced automation solution to make the supply chain faster, more efficient, and more profitable for manufacturers, distributors, and retailers of all sizes.

productsAndServices.description: An end-to-end warehouse automation system combining robotic material handling, automated storage and retrieval, pallet building, inventory management, and AI-driven operational control.
productsAndServices.name: Symbotic Solution

productsAndServices.description: An automated distribution-center system that handles goods in their native cases from pallet receiving through storage, order building, and outbound pallet preparation.
productsAndServices.name: Distribution Solution

productsAndServices.description: A micro-fulfillment system for individual-item and small-unit orders that stores goods in totes and automatically presents them to operators at ergonomic pick stations.
productsAndServices.name: SymMicro

productsAndServices.description: Proprietary software that coordinates warehouse robots, inventory movement, task routing, order sequencing, pallet building, analytics, and real-time operational adjustments.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Driven Software

productsAndServices.description: A portfolio of robotic hardware used for case transport, storage and retrieval, item handling, pallet building, and other automated warehouse operations.
productsAndServices.name: Robots

productsAndServices.description: A managed fulfillment service providing access to fully automated warehouses, robotics, software, fulfillment capacity, and transportation services through Symbotic’s Exol network.
productsAndServices.name: Warehouse-as-a-Service
